title: Responsive Web Design: Make a Layout Fit Phone and Desktop
description:
Learn how flexible layouts, responsive images and a viewport declaration help a page adapt to phones and desktops. Try a responsive card layout.

Try answering: What should happen to side-by-side cards on a narrow phone screen?
